{{Quote|When power is invested in many, it can never be seized by one! That was the plan and the purpose when the Republic was formed.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Constitution''' was the supreme law in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Galactic Constitution was the founding document and highest set of laws in the Republic that were written in [[25,053 BBY]]<ref name="Repubic">{{Holonet|allegiances|galactic-republic|The Galactic Republic}}</ref> by a [[Unidentified House Organa member|member]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> to unify the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and it is widely believed that the same Constitution existed throughout the Republic's existence; however, it certainly underwent drastic revisions and modifications at times (for example, the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]). There is evidence that, as time went on, the Constitution was continually modified to grant more power to the central government.

==Overview==
The Galactic Constitution was finalized at the [[Galactic Constitution Conference]], where it was agreed upon and formally signed.<ref>[[Suns of Fortune|''Suns of Fortune'']]</ref> The Constitution invested executive powers in the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and legislative roles in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and judicial conduct in the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] and the [[Regional Court]]s. It placed the Republic's capital at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], set its official language as [[Old Galactic Standard]] (later [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]), and made its official currency the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]]. It made the [[President of the Senate]] (later [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]) [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and Head of Government and the [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]]. The Senate was granted the authority to levy a military and to regulate trade. The Constitution had strict provisions against persecution of one's personal beliefs.

Two notable clauses of the Constitution were the ''[[Rights of Sentience]]'' and ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]''. The first provided the rights all citizens in the Republic were entitled to, and included the formal outlawing of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]; the second allowed for the Corellian system to enact temporary autonomy in exchange for withdrawal from the Senate. The [[Coruscant Accords (Old Republic)|Coruscant Accords]], possibly part of the Constitution, determined guidelines for Republic membership. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]], thirty-six wartime provisions were listed in the Constitution, and Supreme Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]] enacted all thirty-six of them within days of her election.

The [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|Emergency Powers Act]], passed in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], contained (among other things) an amendment to the Constitution that eliminated term limits for Supreme Chancellors, giving them the choice of when to stand down. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Constitution was increasingly modified by the Senate (among whom a supermajority were loyal to Palpatine) including the controversial [[Statute 312b|Fourth Constitutional Amendment]] and granting more powers to the executive branch. 

With the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Galactic Constitution was replaced by the [[Imperial Charter/Legends|Imperial Charter]] and supressed all its other provisions and permitted several major changes including the nature of the former Galactic Constitution. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] would develop the [[New Republic Common Charter]] that restored the provisions of the Galactic Constitution.
